info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Correspondent Bank Directory Validation-spec
info.description: The Correspondent Bank Directory Validation API enables financial institutions to validate and manage entries in their correspondent bank directory. This endpoint allows users to submit information for validation to ensure accuracy and compliance with regulatory standards. Typical consumers include financial institutions and compliance teams who need to maintain the integrity of their banking partner relationships. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their validation processes and enhance operational efficiency in managing correspondent banking operations.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to validate the correspondent bank information for the specified resource. It ensures all necessary details meet the required criteria for further processing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to validate the details of a correspondent bank in the external agency directory. It requires specific attributes to properly execute the validation against the designated correspondent bank identified by RES-100045.
